description: This file contains private data declarations, macros, inline functions, and prototypes related to the Xtensa Memory Management Unit (MMU) support within the Zephyr RTOS, including page table management, TLB operations, and register manipulations.

methods.name: xtensa_rasid_set
methods.description: Sets the RASID register with a given value.

methods.name: xtensa_rasid_get
methods.description: Retrieves the current value of the RASID register.

methods.name: xtensa_rasid_asid_set
methods.description: Sets a specific ring's ASID in the RASID register.

methods.name: xtensa_init_paging
methods.description: Initializes paging with a specified level 1 page table.

methods.name: xtensa_set_paging
methods.description: Switches to a new page table with a specified ASID.
